title.native: ぷにるはかわいいスライム

description:
Seven years ago, Kotarou made a slime that unexpectedly came to life. He named her Puniru, and they’ve been best friends ever since. The two have grown up a lot over the years, and Puniru is now a beautiful, carefree girl who can shapeshift into other cute forms. But with her spontaneous spirit and wild antics, Kotarou can never catch a break!

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

node.description: A slime life form accidentally created by Kotarou Kawaii in his childhood. She considers herself the cutest slime, and her dream is to become a synonym for “kawaii". Recently, Kotarou has stopped calling her cute, so she is pursuing various “kawaii” forms on a daily basis in order to be recognized as such...!

A second-year student at Lime Junior High School. He has been living with Puniru, whom he created by accident when he was a child. He is a twisted boy who really likes cute things but hides it from everyone around him. He is sometimes pushed around by Puniru's freewheeling behavior, and sometimes gets nervous when he sees how much she has grown up...

A third-year student at Lime Middle School. She is kind to everyone and is the school's Madonna, like a holy mother. She is the object of Kotarou's unrequited love. When she is in front of a child, her maternal instincts are uncontrollable.
Kotarou's classmate. In contrast to his playboy appearance and behavior, he loves children's hobbies and card games.
Kotarou's classmate. She is a rich girl who is next in line to inherit the Kyuthi Land company. She views Puniru as a rival.
Frustrated with his life as a teacher after being expelled from an academy, obsesses over Puniru as a great discovery.
Kotarou's classmate. A gal-type girl who admires celebrities.
Kotarou's classmate. A modern girl who wants to be pampered on social media.
An original character Alice created when she was younger.
Mami and Maika's father. A househusband often mistaken for a schoolboy.
